title: "GSEA Barrier Ion Transport – Per-Cluster Heatmap + NES Strip"
output: html_document
date: "2026-09-08"
---

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(patchwork)
library(GO.db)
set.seed(1)

# ── Load data ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
glial_gsea_results <- qs2::qs_read("./gsea_results_barrier_cells.qs2")
```

```{r definitions}
# ── Cluster × contrast pairs ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
barrier_panels <- tribble(
  ~cluster,                  ~contrast,
  "VLMC-1",                  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "tanycyte-2",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "tanycyte-2",              "early_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "tanycyte-1",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "tanycyte-1",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-1",             "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "ependymal-2",             "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "early_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "early_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "ependymal-2",             "effect_of_sex_young_5x",
  "vascular-endothelial_1",  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "vascular-endothelial_1",  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "vascular-endothelial_2",  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "vascular-pericytes",      "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "vascular-pericytes",      "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m"
)

#monoatomic ion transport
desc_ids <- c("GO:0006811", GOBPOFFSPRING[["GO:0006811"]])

desc_df <- tibble::tibble(
    ID          = desc_ids,
    Description = AnnotationDbi::Term(desc_ids)
)

#inorganic anion transport
desc_ids_2 <- c("GO:0015698", GOBPOFFSPRING[["GO:0015698"]])

desc_df_2 <- tibble::tibble(
    ID          = desc_ids_2,
    Description = AnnotationDbi::Term(desc_ids_2))


desc_df = desc_df %>% bind_rows(desc_df_2) %>% distinct


# ── Ion transport terms per cluster ───────────────────────────────────────────
ion_terms_by_cluster <- glial_gsea_results %>%
  filter(grepl("prolonged_amyloid", contrast)) %>%
  filter(Description %in% desc_df$Description) %>% 
  filter(!grepl("regulation|Regulation", Description)) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < .05) %>%
  distinct(cluster, Description) %>%
  mutate(is_ion = TRUE)

#highlight trends for all 12 altered types w/ion transport differences:
#all VLMC-1 (only one sig contrast)
#tanycyte-1 only those sig in both 5x 14 mo Males and Females
#tanycyte-2 only those sig in both 6 and 14 mo 5x Males 
#ependymal-1 all
#ependymal-2 only those sig in both 6 mo 5x vs ntg m, 14 mo 5x vs ntg m and 14 mo 5x vs ntg f
#vascular_endothelial-1 sig 14 mo both sexes 5x vs ntg
#vascular_endothelial-2 all
#vascular-pericytes all

#for these ones show sig ones with all sig 
term_rules <- tribble(
  ~cluster,                  ~contrast,
  "tanycyte-1",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "tanycyte-1",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "tanycyte-2",              "early_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "tanycyte-2",              "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "early_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "ependymal-2",             "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "vascular-endothelial_1",  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "vascular-endothelial_1",  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f"
)

sig_hits <- glial_gsea_results %>%
  filter(p.adjust < .05) %>%
  distinct(cluster, contrast, Description)

# erms that meet every required contrast for each cluster
passing_terms <- term_rules %>%
  inner_join(sig_hits, by = c("cluster", "contrast")) %>%
  count(cluster, Description, name = "n_hit") %>% 
  mutate(
    keep_sig = case_when(
      cluster == "tanycyte-1" & n_hit == 2 ~ T,
      cluster == "tanycyte-2" & n_hit == 2 ~ T,
      cluster == "ependymal-2" & n_hit == 3 ~ T,
      cluster == "vascular-endothelial_1" & n_hit == 2 ~ T,
      .default = F
    )
  ) %>% 
  filter(keep_sig)

ion_terms_subset <- bind_rows(
  ion_terms_by_cluster %>% filter(!cluster %in% term_rules$cluster),#keep clusters with no filtering 
  ion_terms_by_cluster %>% semi_join(passing_terms, by = c("cluster", "Description")) #keep clusters with filtering
)

# ── Labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cluster_labels <- c(
  "VLMC-1"                 = "VLMC-1 (Dural Border Cells)",
  "tanycyte-1"             = "Tanycyte-1",
  "tanycyte-2"             = "Tanycyte-2 (Beta-2 Tanycytes)",
  "ependymal-1"            = "Ependymal-1",
  "ependymal-2"            = "Ependymal-2",
  "vascular-endothelial_1" = "Endothelial-1 (Veins)",
  "vascular-endothelial_2" = "Endothelial-2 (Arteries)",
  "vascular-pericytes"     = "Pericytes"
)

# Main figure (selected contrasts only)
contrast_labels <- c(
  "effect_of_sex_young_5x"           = "6 Mo 5X F vs M",
  "early_amyloid_contrast_f"     = "6 Mo 5X vs Ntg F",
  "early_amyloid_contrast_m"     = "6 Mo 5X vs Ntg M",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f" = "14 Mo 5X vs Ntg F",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m" = "14 Mo 5X vs Ntg M"
)
contrast_levels     <- unname(contrast_labels)
contrast_levels_rev <- rev(contrast_levels)

# Supplementary (all 12 contrasts)
all_contrast_labels <- c(
  "early_amyloid_contrast_f"         = "6 Mo 5X vs Ntg F",
  "early_amyloid_contrast_m"         = "6 Mo 5X vs Ntg M",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f"     = "14 Mo 5X vs Ntg F",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m"     = "14 Mo 5X vs Ntg M",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f" = "14 Mo 5X vs 6 Mo 5X F",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m" = "14 Mo 5X vs 6 Mo 5X M",
  "aging_contrast_f"                 = "14 Mo Ntg vs 6 Mo Ntg F",
  "aging_contrast_m"                 = "14 Mo Ntg vs 6 Mo Ntg M",
  "effect_of_sex_young_ntg"          = "6 Mo Ntg F vs M",
  "effect_of_sex_young_5x"           = "6 Mo 5X F vs M",
  "effect_of_sex_old_ntg"            = "14 Mo Ntg F vs M",
  "effect_of_sex_old_5x"             = "14 Mo 5X F vs M"
)
all_contrast_levels <- unname(all_contrast_labels)

# ── Filename-safe cluster names ───────────────────────────────────────────────
file_names <- c(
  "VLMC-1"                 = "vlmc-1",
  "tanycyte-1"             = "tanycyte-1",
  "tanycyte-2"             = "tanycyte-2",
  "ependymal-1"            = "ependymal-1",
  "ependymal-2"            = "ependymal-2",
  "vascular-endothelial_1" = "endo-1-venous",
  "vascular-endothelial_2" = "endo-2-arterial",
  "vascular-pericytes"     = "pericytes"
)

cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-2", "tanycyte-1",
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2",
                "vascular-pericytes")

#Plot and save heatmap panels
for(i in 1:length(cell_order)) {
  cur_cluster = cell_order[i]
  #get number of terms to plot (relevant to height) and number of contrasts (relevant to width)
  n_terms     <- ion_terms_subset %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% nrow()
  n_contrasts <- barrier_panels %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% pull(contrast) %>% n_distinct()
  # Scale dimensions to content
  w <- 12 + n_contrasts * 2.2
  h <- 10 + n_terms * 1.1
  #selected ion_terms_subset used since we're not plotting all (will in supplementary)
  cur_contrasts <- barrier_panels %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% pull(contrast) %>% unique()
  #go terms to plot
  cur_terms = ion_terms_subset %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% pull(Description)
  heatmap_data <- glial_gsea_results %>%
    filter(cluster == cur_cluster, contrast %in% cur_contrasts,
           Description %in% cur_terms) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label      = case_when(p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                 p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                 p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                 TRUE ~ ""),
      Description    = str_to_title(Description),
      contrast_label = factor(contrast_labels[contrast],
                              levels = contrast_levels)
    )
    nes_lim <- max(abs(heatmap_data$NES), na.rm = TRUE)
    cur_plot = ggplot(heatmap_data,
                   aes(x = contrast_label, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
    geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 30,vjust = .8,
              fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
    scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
                         limits = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim), name = "NES",
                        guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = h * .5, barheight = h * 1.7)
) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14), drop = TRUE) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
         title = cluster_labels[cur_cluster]) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 40) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"),
      axis.text.y    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",hjust = 1),
      axis.title     = element_blank(),
      panel.grid     = element_blank(),
      plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 60, hjust = 0.5,vjust = 0),
      legend.text    = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold"),
      legend.title   = element_text(size = 40, face = "bold")
    )
  ggsave(paste0("ion-transport-", file_names[cur_cluster],".pdf"),
         cur_plot, width = w, height = h)
}
```

nes plots relative to other sig results - show all ion transport changes,
not just ones highlighted in the top panels
```{r}
#only one don't plot - the one with sig effect_of_sex_young_5x
barrier_panels_nes = barrier_panels %>% filter(!(cluster == "ependymal-2" & contrast == "effect_of_sex_young_5x"))

#create master df with all terms in clusters/contrasts that we want to plot, across all cell types
master_df <- glial_gsea_results %>%
  semi_join(barrier_panels_nes, by = c("cluster", "contrast")) %>% #filter contrasts/clusters
  left_join(ion_terms_by_cluster, by = c("cluster", "Description")) %>% #add the is_ion column to show these are the ones we're interested in
  mutate(
    is_ion         = replace_na(is_ion, FALSE),
    contrast_label = factor(contrast_labels[contrast],
                            levels = rev(unname(contrast_labels)))
  ) %>% 
  filter(p.adjust < .05) #only plotting sig terms so only need these

# --- Shared theme ----------------------------------------------------------
theme_barrier <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text          = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", size = 22),
        axis.title.x       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
        axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11, hjust = 0.5))



cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-2", "tanycyte-1",
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2", "vascular-pericytes")

cell_plots <- list()

for (cur_cluster in cell_order) {

  cur_df     <- filter(master_df, cluster == cur_cluster) %>% droplevels()
  cur_bg_sig <- filter(cur_df, !is_ion, p.adjust < 0.05)
  cur_fg_sig <- filter(cur_df,  is_ion, p.adjust < 0.05)
  cell_plots[[cur_cluster]] <- ggplot(cur_df, aes(NES, contrast_label)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
    geom_jitter(data = cur_bg_sig,
                height = 0.18, width = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.28, color = "grey65") +
    geom_jitter(data = cur_fg_sig,
                height = 0.18, width = 0, size = 4, alpha = .7,
                shape = 21, fill = "#C0392B", color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
    scale_y_discrete(drop = TRUE) +
    labs(x = "NES", y = NULL, title = cluster_labels[cur_cluster]) +
    theme_barrier
}

# --- Combine via patchwork: 3 rows, ependymal centered --------------------
row1 <- cell_plots[["VLMC-1"]] |
        cell_plots[["tanycyte-2"]] |
        cell_plots[["tanycyte-1"]]

row2 <- plot_spacer() |
        cell_plots[["ependymal-1"]] |
        cell_plots[["ependymal-2"]] |
        plot_spacer()
row2 <- row2 + plot_layout(widths = c(0.5, 1, 1, 0.5))

row3 <- cell_plots[["vascular-endothelial_1"]] |
        cell_plots[["vascular-endothelial_2"]] |
        cell_plots[["vascular-pericytes"]]

combined <- row1 / row2 / row3

ggsave("barrier-ion-transport-nes-combined.pdf", combined,
       width = 25, height = 10)
```


Plot supplementary heatmap, with all contrast results for pathways that were 
significant in either 14 mo 5x vs ntg M or 14 mo 5x vs ntg F comparisons.
```{r supplementary_function}
cell_order <- c("VLMC-1", "tanycyte-1","tanycyte-2", 
                "ependymal-1", "ependymal-2",
                "vascular-endothelial_1", "vascular-endothelial_2", "vascular-pericytes")


plot_list_supp = list()
for(cur_cluster in cell_order) {
  #all significant terms in either 14 mo 5x M or F 
  total_number_sig_terms_cur_cluster = ion_terms_by_cluster %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% nrow()
  # 12 contrasts on x-axis; height scales with term count
  h <- 10 + n_terms * 1.7
  cur_cluster_terms_to_plot = ion_terms_by_cluster %>% filter(cluster == cur_cluster) %>% pull(Description)

  #filter to the cluster/descriptions to plot, and get all comparison results
  cur_plot_heatmap_data <- glial_gsea_results %>%
    filter(cluster == cur_cluster,
           contrast %in% names(all_contrast_labels),
           Description %in% cur_cluster_terms_to_plot) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label      = case_when(p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
                                 p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
                                 p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
                                 TRUE ~ ""),
      Description    = str_to_title(Description),
      contrast_label = factor(all_contrast_labels[contrast],
                              levels = all_contrast_levels)
    )

  nes_lim <- max(abs(cur_plot_heatmap_data$NES), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  cur_supp_plot = ggplot(cur_plot_heatmap_data, aes(x = contrast_label, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
      geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 30, vjust = .8,
                fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
      scale_fill_distiller(palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
                           limits = c(-nes_lim, nes_lim), name = "NES",
                           guide = guide_colorbar(barwidth = h * .4,
                                                  barheight = h * 1.8)) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 14), drop = TRUE) +
      scale_y_discrete(labels = \(x) str_wrap(x, width = 25)) +
      labs(x = NULL, y = NULL,
           title = cluster_labels[cur_cluster]) +
      theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 45) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x    = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1,
                                      face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text.y    = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black", hjust = 1),
        axis.title     = element_blank(),
        panel.grid     = element_blank(),
        plot.title     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 100, hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0),
        legend.text    = element_text(size = 50, face = "bold"),
        legend.title   = element_text(size = 60, face = "bold")
      )
  
  plot_list_supp[[cur_cluster]] = cur_supp_plot
  
}

combined_supp <- wrap_plots(plot_list_supp, ncol = 2,heights = c(4,4,6,2))

ggsave("combined_supp_ion.pdf",combined_supp, width = 80, height = 80, limitsize = F)
```
